title: Add gpt-realtime connection via Azure and Databricks
description:
This is a really neat tool and enjoyed your team showing off ggbot at posit::conf!

Since gpt-realtime can be used through Azure and Databricks, it would be ideal to be able to use these endpoints as well out of the box. Is there any way to add that functionality?

title: Difficulty Installing with renv
description:
Running `renv::install("posit-dev/shinyrealtime")` fails because it expects the DESCRIPTION file to be at the repository root, but in this repository, the R package is located in the `pkg-r/` subdirectory. 

This is fixable by running either:

`renv::install("posit-dev/shinyrealtime/pkg-r")`
or
`renv::install("posit-dev/shinyrealtime", subdir = "pkg-r")`

But, this could be a barrier to people trying to use the package who aren't able to easily install it.
